ground_truth.cause: In batch, asset-syncer references the nonexistent missing-hotfix image tag in the configured registry, so its container cannot be pulled.
ground_truth.impact: Asset-syncer cannot start. The shop has no runtime dependency on it; this is not an application crash or a general registry outage.
ground_truth.mitigation: Build and publish the intended asset-syncer implementation under the referenced tag, or change the deployment to the built asset-syncer image/tag recorded for this run. Verify image availability and rollout; an arbitrary replacement image is not a demonstrated fix.

causal_change.reason: This scenario does not provide a controlled introducing commit and recorded product access to its history.
